newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Earthquake rocks Taiwan, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake rocks Taiwan, no damage reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 7.0 on the Richter scale struck on Friday off Taiwan, but there were no immediate reports of damage.
The Central Weather Bureau said the quake's epicentre was 41.1 km (26 miles) due south of Taiwan's offshore island of Lanyu and some 40 km (25 miles) beneath the earth's surface.
The quake was felt in most parts of the island's central and southern region.
In the capital of Taipei, the quake swayed buildings for more than 20 seconds.
